content.title: SBN Reacts: What is Your Prediction for Mizzou vs Miami (FL) in the First Round?
content.text: Welcome to SB Nation Reacts, a survey of fans across the NCAA. Throughout the year we ask questions of the most plugged-in Missouri fans and fans across the country. Sign up here to participate in the weekly emailed surveys.We’re inching closer to watching Missouri Basketball in the NCAA Tournament again as Mizzou and Miami (FL) will tip-off late Friday night in St. Louis — the last scheduled game to start in the first round.Making the NCAA Tournament is becoming a regular occurrence under Dennis Gates as Missouri has now made it back-to-back years and three out of the last four seasons. The next step for this program is finding success in the postseason — and that opportunity starts on Friday night with a Mizzou-heavy crowd at the Enterprise Center. Can the Tigers take advantage of this situation?Per the FanDuel odds — No. 7 seed Miami (FL) comes in as 1.5-point favorites over 10-seeded Mizzou in the West Region first round.Missouri has shown they can beat anybody in the country with wins over Florida, Tennessee, Kentucky, Vanderbilt, and Texas A&M, but their inconsistencies throughout the season have provided good reason why they’re the underdog in this one. Meanwhile, Miami (FL) put together a more complete season in Year One under Jai Lucas going 23-8 (13-5 ACC) — earning a spot in the latest AP Top 25 poll at No. 25.Either way, this should be a fun one — and one of the better games in the first round of the NCAA Tournament. In our latest SBN Reacts, we ask you this — what is your prediction for Mizzou vs Miami (FL)? (Be sure to join the Rock M Nation Bracket Challenge on ESPN as well).1 Comment
